subject: Pilot results & quick ask: short quote or 15-min call
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hamidi <alex@nimblepay.com>, Priya Rao <priya@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot results & quick ask: short quote or 15-min call

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the 3-week inference pilot. We wrapped the final run yesterday and wanted to share the highlights and a small favor ask for marketing/reference purposes. I attached a 2-page summary and a ZIP with a couple dashboard screenshots.

Key outcomes (pilot vs. your previous on-prem baseline):
- Cost per 1k generated tokens: down ~45%
- Average throughput (tokens/sec): ~2.1x
- P99 generation latency (same prompt mix): 420ms → 180ms
- Production success rate (no OOM/serve errors): improved from 92% → 99.4%
- Estimated monthly infra spend for projected workload: ~$5.6k (vs. ~$9.8k baseline)

Why this matters: the combination of improved latency + consistent throughput let your payments fraud detection pipeline tighten the batching window while staying within SLA — that’s what drove the cost and latency wins above.

Small asks: would NimblePay be open to either of these two quick options?
1) A 1-2 sentence customer quote we can use in a short case blurb (example: “With Redwood, we cut inference costs by ~45% and improved latency, which let us…”)
2) A 15-minute call with one of your engineering/product leaders and our marketing lead to capture a few on-record soundbites and a screenshot of the dashboard

We respect whatever level of exposure you prefer (anonymized metrics, review before publish, or internal-only collateral). If you’re open, we can share a draft quote for you to approve — takes 10 minutes.

Suggested times for a short call (PDT): Mon 9/15 11:00-11:30, Tue 9/16 09:00-09:30, Tue 9/16 15:00-15:30. If none work, tell me what does.

Attachments: [Attachment: pilot-results-summary.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: dashboard-screenshots.zip (ZIP)]

Thanks again — excited about where you can take this in production.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.ai
